archetypes.label: Five-speed synchromesh H-pattern, dogleg gate with 1st down and left, clutch to pull away, lift on upshift, blip optional
archetypes.basis: The first archetype with a dogleg gate, and the reason the id carries one where no other does: the gate is mechanism, and without it this would be indistinguishable from the standard-gate five-speed synchromesh archetype it otherwise resembles. Two curated records share this exact block, both Group A homologation specials built to race each other, both with their construction established from their own FIA form. The blip is optional because a synchromesh does not need one to engage, which is the same rule every other synchromesh record in the dataset follows.
